overlap_note: May overlap with Project- and Problem-Based Learning, Case-Based Learning, Community Learning, and Entrepreneurial Learning.
review_note: Check that professional or partner language describes an authentic learning task rather than a generic context statement.

overlap_note: Separated from Case-Based Learning by tutor revision. A real-world scenario alone is not a simulation unless the activity recreates, mimics, or role-plays a setting or process.
review_note: Do not inherit Simulation from a case-study label or from Case-Based Learning evidence.

representative_review_evidence: AS06 Business Models Submission of partner's business, operating models, and IS architecture; AS12 Group Report Written report
overlap_note: May overlap with Work-Integrated and Applied Learning and Project- and Problem-Based Learning. Industry context does not exclude a case-based classification.
review_note: An administrative assessment type such as 'Case studies' is retained as a weak review signal and is not sufficient by itself for a positive classification.

representative_positive_evidence: LO03 Learning outcome 3; WK01 Week 01: Unit Introduction & Project Immersion; WK03 Week 03: Problem & Opportunity Scoping
representative_review_evidence: WK04 Week 04: Project Planning; WK10 Week 10: Implementation Planning
overlap_note: May overlap with Work-Integrated and Applied Learning when projects involve clients or industry partners, and with Case-Based Learning when cases are used inside a project.
review_note: Do not classify from the generic word 'project' alone; require a problem, challenge, immersion, investigation, or explicit project/problem-based method.

overlap_note: May overlap with Work-Integrated and Applied Learning when the authentic partner is a community organisation.
review_note: Require an explicit community, service-learning, field-study, or community-of-practice activity.

representative_review_evidence: WK07 Week 07: Ideation; WK08 Week 08: Prototyping
overlap_note: May overlap with Project- and Problem-Based Learning and Simulation when learners develop or simulate a venture.
review_note: Generic ideation, pitching, or prototyping is a review signal unless explicitly connected to entrepreneurship, a startup, a product-development project, or a venture.

overlap_note: May overlap with Simulation, Hybrid Learning, or Entrepreneurial Learning. Merely studying digital technology is not evidence that learning is technology-mediated.
review_note: Require the technology to be part of the learning method, not only the subject matter.

overlap_note: May overlap with Technology-Mediated Learning, but requires an explicit combination of physical and online modes.
review_note: Online materials alone are insufficient; require an explicit hybrid, blended, flipped, hyflex, or mixed-mode design.
